The repair performs no paid or quota-consuming model call, preserves fail-closed behavior for unavailable providers, and tests that scheduler or catalog refresh failures cannot cause an uncontrolled retry loop.

The checkout /home/alex/repos/.repoground-sources/heimgewebe__grabowski__main receives an explicit manager- and provenance-bound classification of active-retain, durable-retain, quarantine-eligible or cleanup-eligible, with exact repository, ref, tree, process, lease and recovery evidence.
Unknown, foreign, active, changed, symlinked or lease-bound source state is never deleted, reset or adopted; any cleanup effect uses the existing typed lifecycle path and preserves recovery receipts.

Focused and full relevant tests, exact diff-bound review and required CI pass; merged revisions are deployed, the probe timer completes truthfully, RepoGround Fleet reports the source decision, failed-unit and checkout counts are read back, and Grabowski remains healthy.
